sections.title: Content Gaps
sections.sql: select f.name,f.network,count(p.id)::int as next_week_posts from profiles f left join posts p on f.id=p.profile_id and p.planned_at between now() and now()+interval '7 days' and p.state not in ('published','archived') group by f.id order by f.name

sections.title: Campaign Review
sections.sql: select campaign,count(*)::int as posts,sum(clicks) as known_clicks,count(*) filter(where clicks is null)::int as missing_clicks from post_performance where state='published' group by campaign order by campaign
sections.note: Latest snapshot per post; missing values remain unknown. Network definitions differ.

sections.title: Metric Gaps
sections.sql: select code,title,as_of,clicks from post_performance where state='published' and (as_of<current_date-7 or as_of is null or clicks is null) order by code
